rules_dates: the date of the commit that changed the rule, not the first run that used it

rules.title: Physical AI Radar: trilingual daily frontier radar
Read the arXiv category feeds when the API answers 406 to everything
Keep off-topic posts and all-preprint days off the radar
rules.note: the qualifying gate; per_source and per_evidence caps

rules.title: sources: add TRI, Leiphone (zh) and MONOist (ja), and read Chinese and Japanese
Fewer items in the wrong lane: phrase the ambiguous keywords, break VLA ties
fetch: page_watch for feedless official sources via local Firecrawl (#154)
sources: mainstream and professional feeds, attention (heat) for ranking, highlights quota
rules.note: arXiv at most half of the day; slots reserved for an official and a trending item

rules.title: select: a capped item keeps one lane slot (AW-0 missed on 10-22) (#166)
page_watch: static_mode live for physical-intelligence and unitree, and the tests that assumed observe
page_watch: read figure and 1x with the static fetcher (observed: HTTP 200, robots allowed, 21 and 15 links), keep the other three on Firecrawl
Stop reading the three GitHub release atom feeds (github.com robots.txt disallows .atom paths); a feed can be switched off with enabled (#209)
rules.note: the LeRobot, Isaac Lab and MuJoCo release feeds; the commit is on main through the merge of #209 (4023965)

rules.title: page_watch: stop reading physical-intelligence (reads failed on every run from 11-12 to 11-16: robots.txt answered 429 in the runs of 11-12 to 11-15, and the 11-16 run sent no request); an entry can be switched off with enabled
rules.note: the page is listed as not covered; figure, 1x and unitree are unchanged. Reading it failed on every run from 11-12 to 11-16 (the 11-11 run read it). The radar stops asking its host for anything with this change

rules.title: Reserve highlight slots for industry events: two of the day's slots go to the best posts that report funding, M&A, a listing, a production milestone or policy, and such posts need a score of 0.6 instead of 0.9 (event_min_score) (#214)
rules.note: per_lane 2 and per_day 8 are unchanged; a paper never earns the event bonus or the slot; the commit is on main through the merge of #214 (33a7110)

rules.title: Read the three GitHub release feeds (LeRobot, Isaac Lab, MuJoCo) from the GitHub API again: the newest release of each repository, one request each, no redirect followed, and a reply that is not a well-formed release list is a bad reply, not an item (#215)
rules.note: the merge commit of #215 on main (2026-11-17 03:18 +0800); its own commits, b9bb83c and 5479dce, are dated 2026-11-16. #225 (382df9d) the same day made a link read as strict UTF-8 and every entry of the reply checked, which is part of the same read. The three feeds had not been read since #209 stopped their atom feeds; the 2026-11-17 run read one release from each (per_source github-lerobot, github-isaaclab, github-mujoco: 1 each). per_lane 2 and per_day 8 are the code defaults at this commit

rules.title: Stop reading MONOist (ITmedia, Japanese): the robots.txt of rss.itmedia.co.jp answered 200 but not as a robots.txt on 2026-11-17; the feed is switched off with enabled
rules.note: the log of the 2026-11-17 run says only that the answer was 200 and not taken as a robots.txt (an HTML body, a final address that is not the host's /robots.txt, or a content type other than text/plain, checks added by #210); which one is not recorded, and the answer itself was not looked at. The host is not requested while the feed is off. No other feed in data/sources.json has lang ja, so this removes the radar's only Japanese-language feed

source_evidence_note: each source's evidence class in the configuration at the time of the export, not on the day it failed
